safety.en: Ease off if the front of the shoulder aches.
safety.zh: 膊頭前面痛就放鬆啲。

easier.en: Take a smaller step.
easier.zh: 踏細步啲。

harder.en: Draw the shoulder blade back and down before turning.
harder.zh: 轉身之前先將肩胛骨向後向下收。

summary.en: Forearm on the doorframe with the elbow above shoulder height, then step through.
summary.zh: 前臂貼住門框，手踭高過膊頭，然後踏前。

steps.en: Stand in a doorway. Place your right forearm on the frame with the elbow a little above shoulder height.
steps.zh: 企喺門口，右前臂貼住門框，手踭高過膊頭少少。

steps.en: Step your right foot through the doorway.
steps.zh: 右腳踏過門口。

steps.en: Let your chest move forward and slightly down, keeping the shoulder away from the ear.
steps.zh: 胸口向前同微微向下移，膊頭唔好貼近耳仔。

steps.en: Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換邊。

feel.en: In the lower part of the chest and deep near the front of the armpit.
feel.zh: 下胸，同腋下前面嘅深層。

mistakes.en: Arching the lower back.
Letting the elbow slide down the frame.

safety.en: Keep the ribs down.
safety.zh: 肋骨收返落去。

safety.en: Stop if you feel tingling down the arm.
safety.zh: 手臂有麻痺感就停止。

easier.en: Lower the elbow to shoulder height.
easier.zh: 手踭放低到同膊頭一樣高。

harder.en: Turn the chest slightly away from the arm.
harder.zh: 胸口微微轉離手臂。

summary.en: Lying on your back, your partner eases the fronts of your shoulders toward the floor.
summary.zh: 仰臥，拍檔輕輕將你兩邊膊頭前面壓向地面。

steps.en: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms resting by your sides, palms up.
steps.zh: 仰臥，屈膝，雙手放喺身旁，掌心向上。

steps.en: Your partner kneels behind your head and places the heels of their hands on the fronts of your shoulders.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你頭後面，掌根放喺你兩邊膊頭前面。

steps.en: As you breathe out, your partner presses the shoulders slowly down and slightly toward your feet.
steps.zh: 你呼氣嗰陣，拍檔慢慢將膊頭向下、微微向腳嘅方向壓。

steps.en: Hold, then your partner releases gradually.
steps.zh: 保持，然後拍檔逐少逐少放鬆。

feel.en: Deep under the outer chest, just below the collarbone near the shoulder.
feel.zh: 胸外側深層，鎖骨對落、近膊頭嗰個位。

mistakes.en: The partner pressing on the collarbones or throat.
mistakes.zh: 拍檔壓住鎖骨或者喉嚨。

mistakes.en: Arching the back as the shoulders go down.

safety.en: Light, slow pressure only.
safety.zh: 只可以用輕而慢嘅力。

safety.en: Agree on a "stop" word first.
safety.zh: 事先講好一個「停」字。

easier.en: The partner simply rests their hands without pressing.
easier.zh: 拍檔只係將手擱住，唔使壓。

harder.en: Place a rolled towel lengthways under the spine first.
harder.zh: 先喺脊骨下面直放一條捲起嘅毛巾。

summary.en: Lying on your side, sweep the top arm open to the other side and back.
summary.zh: 側瞓，上面隻手打開去另一邊，再合返埋。

steps.en: Lie on your left side with hips and knees bent to a right angle, arms straight out in front, palms together.
steps.zh: 向左側瞓，髖同膝頭都屈成直角，雙手向前伸直，合掌。

steps.en: Keeping the knees together, lift your right arm up and over, following the hand with your eyes.
steps.zh: 膝頭保持貼埋，右手向上再打開去另一邊，雙眼跟住隻手。

steps.en: Let the right shoulder blade sink toward the floor behind you and pause for a breath.
steps.zh: 右邊肩胛骨向後面地面沉，停一下呼吸。

steps.en: Close the arm back slowly. Keep moving for the full time, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 慢慢合返隻手。做足成段時間，然後換邊。

feel.en: Across the chest and along the side of the ribs under the armpit.
feel.zh: 胸口，同腋下對落嘅肋骨側面。

mistakes.en: Letting the knees separate or lift.
Swinging the arm quickly.

safety.en: Move only as far as the knees stay stacked.
safety.zh: 膝頭疊得住嘅範圍內先郁。

safety.en: Put a pillow under the head.
safety.zh: 頭下面墊個枕頭。

easier.en: Keep the elbow bent with the hand behind the head.
easier.zh: 手踭屈起，隻手放喺後腦。

harder.en: Pause for three breaths each time the arm is open.
harder.zh: 每次打開都停三下呼吸。

summary.en: Hold your shins and lean back so the shoulder blades are drawn up and apart.
summary.zh: 揸住小腿向後挨，將肩胛骨向上向外拉開。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，屈膝，腳掌貼地。

steps.en: Reach forward and hold the fronts of your shins, or behind the knees.
steps.zh: 向前伸手，揸住小腿前面或者膝頭後面。

steps.en: Lean your trunk back until the arms are straight, and round the middle of your back.
steps.zh: 上身向後挨到手臂伸直，中背拱起。

steps.en: Let the shoulder blades slide up and forward. Hold, then sit tall.
steps.zh: 等肩胛骨向上向前滑。保持，然後坐返直。

feel.en: In the middle of the back, below and between the shoulder blades.
feel.zh: 中背，兩邊肩胛骨之間同對落。

mistakes.en: Bending the elbows, which takes the stretch away.
Rounding only the lower back.

safety.en: Keep the neck relaxed.
safety.zh: 條頸放鬆。

safety.en: Avoid if flexing the spine is painful.
safety.zh: 向前拱會痛就唔好做。

easier.en: Hold behind the thighs and lean back less.
easier.zh: 揸住大腿後面，挨少啲。

harder.en: Cross the wrists and hold the opposite shins.
harder.zh: 手腕交叉，揸住對面嘅小腿。

summary.en: From child's pose, walk both hands to one side.
summary.zh: 由嬰兒式開始，雙手爬去一邊。

steps.en: Start in child's pose: hips back toward the heels, arms stretched out in front.
steps.zh: 由嬰兒式開始：臀部坐向腳跟，雙手向前伸。

steps.en: Walk both hands over to the left, keeping the hips where they are.
steps.zh: 雙手一齊爬去左邊，臀部保持原位。

steps.en: Press the right palm down and sink the right hip back toward the heel.
steps.zh: 右手掌向下壓，右邊臀部坐返向腳跟。

steps.en: Hold, breathing into the right side, then walk to the other side.
steps.zh: 保持，吸氣到右邊身側，然後爬去另一邊。

feel.en: From the lower back up the side of the trunk to the armpit.
feel.zh: 由腰沿住身側上到腋下。

mistakes.en: Letting the hips follow the hands.
mistakes.zh: 臀部跟住雙手移咗過去。

mistakes.en: Lifting the far hip off the heel.

safety.en: Put a cushion between hips and heels if the knees are tight.
safety.zh: 膝頭緊嘅話，喺臀部同腳跟之間放個咕臣。

safety.en: Skip it with a knee injury.
safety.zh: 膝頭有傷就唔好做。

easier.en: Walk the hands only a little to the side.
easier.zh: 雙手爬少少就夠。

harder.en: Place the far hand on top of the near hand.
harder.zh: 遠嗰隻手疊喺近嗰隻手上面。

summary.en: Sit back on your heels and lean back a little on your hands.
summary.zh: 坐返落腳跟，雙手撐後微微向後挨。

steps.en: Kneel with knees together and the tops of the feet flat on the floor.
steps.zh: 雙膝貼埋跪低，腳背貼地。

steps.en: Sit your hips back onto your heels.
steps.zh: 臀部坐返落腳跟。

steps.en: Place your hands on the floor behind you and lean back slightly, keeping the knees down.
steps.zh: 雙手撐喺身後地上，微微向後挨，膝頭保持貼地。

steps.en: Hold, then come forward and stand up slowly.
steps.zh: 保持，然後返向前，慢慢起身。

feel.en: Across the front of both thighs, just above the knees.
feel.zh: 兩邊大腿前面，膝頭對上。

mistakes.en: Letting the knees lift or spread.
Arching the lower back to lean further.

safety.en: Skip this if deep knee bending hurts.
safety.zh: 深屈膝會痛就唔好做。

safety.en: Place a cushion between heels and hips if needed.
safety.zh: 有需要就喺腳跟同臀部之間放個咕臣。

easier.en: Stay upright with a cushion on the heels.
easier.zh: 腳跟上面墊咕臣，上身保持挺直。

harder.en: Lower onto the forearms behind you.
harder.zh: 向後用前臂撐地。

name.zh: 伸展帶後大腿伸展（腳拉過中線）

summary.en: Raise the straight leg with a strap, then draw it across the body.
summary.zh: 用伸展帶抬高伸直嘅腳，再拉過身體另一邊。

steps.en: Lie on your back with a strap around the ball of your right foot.
steps.zh: 仰臥，將伸展帶套住右腳前掌。

steps.en: Raise the right leg straight up until you feel the back of the thigh.
steps.zh: 右腳伸直抬高，直到大腿後面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold the strap in your left hand and draw the leg a little across to the left, turning the toes slightly inward.
steps.zh: 用左手揸住伸展帶，將隻腳拉向左邊少少，腳趾微微向內轉。

steps.en: Keep the right hip on the floor. Hold, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 右邊臀部保持貼地。保持，然後換腳。

feel.en: Along the outer back of the thigh, toward the outside of the knee.
feel.zh: 大腿後面偏外側，去到膝頭外側。

mistakes.en: Letting the hip roll off the floor.
Bending the knee.

safety.en: Move the leg across only a few centimetres.
safety.zh: 隻腳只拉過幾厘米。

safety.en: Stop if you feel pain behind the knee.
safety.zh: 膝頭後面痛就停止。

easier.en: Bend the other knee with the foot on the floor.
easier.zh: 另一隻腳屈膝踩地。

harder.en: Pull the toes back toward you.
harder.zh: 腳趾勾向自己。

name.en: Strap hamstring stretch, leg out to the side
name.zh: 伸展帶後大腿伸展（腳向外打開）

summary.en: Raise the straight leg with a strap, then let it open out to the side.
summary.zh: 用伸展帶抬高伸直嘅腳，再向外側打開。

steps.en: Lie on your back with a strap around the ball of your right foot.
steps.zh: 仰臥，將伸展帶套住右腳前掌。

steps.en: Raise the right leg straight up until you feel the back of the thigh.
steps.zh: 右腳伸直抬高，直到大腿後面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold the strap in your right hand and let the leg open out to the right, turning the toes slightly outward.
steps.zh: 用右手揸住伸展帶，等隻腳向右邊打開，腳趾微微向外轉。

steps.en: Keep the left hip heavy on the floor. Hold, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 左邊臀部保持壓實地面。保持，然後換腳。

feel.en: Along the inner back of the thigh, toward the inside of the knee.
feel.zh: 大腿後面偏內側，去到膝頭內側。

mistakes.en: The opposite hip lifting.
Letting the leg drop quickly.

safety.en: Lower the leg under control.
safety.zh: 隻腳要有控制咁放低。

safety.en: Ease off if you feel strain in the groin.
safety.zh: 腹股溝有扯住嘅感覺就放鬆啲。

easier.en: Open the leg only a little.
easier.zh: 隻腳打開少少就夠。

harder.en: Keep the other leg straight and pressed into the floor.
harder.zh: 另一隻腳伸直壓實地面。

name.zh: 雙人後大腿收縮放鬆伸展（PNF）

summary.en: Press the raised leg into your partner for a few seconds, relax, then go a little further.
summary.zh: 抬起嘅腳向拍檔頂幾秒，放鬆，再拉深少少。

steps.en: Lie on your back. Your partner raises your straight right leg to the first point of stretch and rests it on their shoulder.
steps.zh: 仰臥，拍檔將你伸直嘅右腳抬到啱啱有拉緊感，擱喺佢膊頭上。

steps.en: Press the leg down into your partner at about half strength for 6 seconds while they hold still.
steps.zh: 用大約一半力將隻腳向下頂住拍檔 6 秒，拍檔頂住唔郁。

steps.en: Relax and breathe out. Your partner raises the leg a little further and holds for about 20 seconds.
steps.zh: 放鬆、呼氣。拍檔將隻腳再抬高少少，保持大約 20 秒。

steps.en: That is one set. Repeat, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 以上係一組。重複，然後換腳。

feel.en: Along the back of the raised thigh, a little deeper after each contraction.
feel.zh: 抬起嗰隻腳嘅大腿後面，每次收縮之後會深少少。

mistakes.en: Pushing at full strength.
The partner moving the leg while you are still pushing.
mistakes.zh: 你仲頂緊嗰陣拍檔已經郁隻腳。

safety.en: Agree on the signals for "push", "relax" and "stop".
safety.zh: 事先講好「頂」、「放鬆」同「停」嘅口令。

safety.en: Do this only when the muscle is warm.
safety.zh: 肌肉暖咗先好做。

easier.en: Push at about a quarter strength.
easier.zh: 用大約四分一力去頂。

harder.en: After relaxing, gently pull the leg toward you with your own hip muscles as the partner moves it.
harder.zh: 放鬆之後，拍檔郁隻腳嗰陣，自己用髖部肌肉輕輕將腳拉向自己。

summary.en: Soles of the feet together, knees out, and hinge forward.
summary.zh: 兩隻腳掌底貼埋，膝頭向外，上身向前傾。

steps.en: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out to the sides.
steps.zh: 坐直，兩隻腳掌底貼埋，膝頭向兩邊打開。

steps.en: Hold your ankles and draw the heels in to a comfortable distance.
steps.zh: 揸住腳眼，將腳跟拉近到舒服嘅位置。

steps.en: Keeping the back long, hinge your chest forward from the hips.
steps.zh: 背部保持拉長，由髖部將胸口向前傾。

steps.en: Rest the elbows on the inner thighs without pressing. Hold.
steps.zh: 手踭擱喺大腿內側，唔好壓。保持。

feel.en: High on the inner thighs, close to the groin.
feel.zh: 大腿內側嘅上段，近腹股溝。

mistakes.en: Bouncing the knees.
Rounding the back to get the head down.

safety.en: Never force the knees down.
safety.zh: 千祈唔好硬壓膝頭。

safety.en: Avoid with a groin strain.
safety.zh: 腹股溝拉傷就唔好做。

easier.en: Sit on a cushion and move the feet further away.
easier.zh: 坐喺咕臣上，雙腳放遠啲。

harder.en: Bring the heels closer to the body.
harder.zh: 腳跟拉近身體啲。

summary.en: Sitting with both knees bent, rotate the knees from one side to the other.
summary.zh: 坐低雙膝屈起，膝頭由一邊轉去另一邊。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet wider than your hips, hands on the floor behind you.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，屈膝，雙腳闊過髖部，雙手撐喺身後。

steps.en: Slowly lower both knees to the right until both legs rest on the floor.
steps.zh: 慢慢將兩邊膝頭倒向右邊，直到兩隻腳都擱喺地上。

steps.en: Pause for a breath, then lift the knees and lower them to the left.
steps.zh: 停一下呼吸，然後提起膝頭，倒向左邊。

steps.en: Keep switching slowly for the full time.
steps.zh: 慢慢轉換，做足成段時間。

feel.en: Deep in the buttock of the front leg and the outer hip of the back leg.
feel.zh: 前面隻腳嘅臀部深層，同後面隻腳嘅髖外側。

mistakes.en: Dropping the knees quickly.
Collapsing the chest.

safety.en: Skip it if either knee hurts.
safety.zh: 任何一邊膝頭痛就唔好做。

safety.en: Keep the feet in place; let the hips do the turning.
safety.zh: 雙腳保持原位，由髖部去轉。

easier.en: Lean back further on the hands.
easier.zh: 雙手撐後啲，上身挨多啲。

harder.en: Take the hands off the floor and sit tall.
harder.zh: 雙手離地，坐直。

summary.en: Lying on your back with feet wide, let one knee fall inward.
summary.zh: 仰臥，雙腳分開，等一邊膝頭向內倒。

steps.en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, wider than your hips.
steps.zh: 仰臥，屈膝，腳掌貼地，雙腳闊過髖部。

steps.en: Let your right knee fall inward toward the floor, keeping the foot where it is.
steps.zh: 右膝向內倒向地面，隻腳保持原位。

steps.en: Rest your left foot lightly on the outside of the right knee to add a little weight.
steps.zh: 左腳輕輕擱喺右膝外側，加少少重量。

steps.en: Keep both hips on the floor. Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 兩邊臀部保持貼地。保持，然後換邊。

feel.en: Deep in the back of the hip and buttock of the knee that is dropped in.
feel.zh: 向內倒嗰邊嘅髖後面同臀部深層。

mistakes.en: The hip lifting off the floor.
Pressing hard with the top foot.

safety.en: Stop if the inside of the knee hurts.
safety.zh: 膝頭內側痛就停止。

safety.en: Use light pressure only.
safety.zh: 只用輕力。

easier.en: Let the knee fall in without the other foot on it.
easier.zh: 唔使用另一隻腳壓，淨係等膝頭倒落去。

harder.en: Move the foot of the stretched leg further out to the side.
harder.zh: 被拉嗰隻腳再放出啲。

name.en: Kneeling lunge with overhead side reach

summary.en: In a kneeling lunge, raise the arm on the back-leg side and lean away.
summary.zh: 跪姿弓步，舉高後腳嗰邊隻手，上身挨向另一邊。

steps.en: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot flat in front.
steps.zh: 右膝跪地，左腳掌喺前面踩實。

steps.en: Tuck your tailbone under and shift the hips slightly forward.
steps.zh: 尾龍骨向下收，髖部稍為向前推。

steps.en: Raise your right arm straight overhead.
steps.zh: 右手向上舉直。

steps.en: Lean your trunk to the left without twisting. Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 上身挨向左邊，唔好扭。保持，然後換邊。

feel.en: Deep in the front of the hip of the back leg, running up into the side of the lower abdomen.
feel.zh: 後腳嘅髖部前面深層，一直上到下腹側面。

mistakes.en: Arching the lower back.
Twisting the chest toward the floor.

safety.en: Pad the back knee.
safety.zh: 後膝下面墊軟啲。

safety.en: Hold a chair with the other hand if you wobble.
safety.zh: 企唔穩就用另一隻手扶住櫈。

easier.en: Keep the hand on the hip and lean only slightly.
easier.zh: 隻手叉腰，挨少少就夠。

harder.en: Turn the chest a little toward the front leg at the end position.
harder.zh: 到位之後胸口微微轉向前腳嗰邊。

summary.en: Lie back at the edge of a bed, hug one knee and let the other leg hang.
summary.zh: 喺床邊瞓低，抱住一邊膝頭，另一隻腳垂落去。

steps.en: Sit at the very edge of a bed, then lie back while hugging both knees to your chest.
steps.zh: 坐喺床嘅最邊，抱住兩邊膝頭瞓低。

steps.en: Keep holding the left knee and slowly lower the right leg so it hangs off the edge.
steps.zh: 繼續抱住左膝，慢慢放低右腳，等佢垂喺床邊外面。

steps.en: Let the right thigh relax toward the floor, keeping the lower back flat on the bed.
steps.zh: 右大腿放鬆向地面垂，腰保持貼住張床。

steps.en: Hold, then hug the right knee back in and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後抱返右膝，換邊。

feel.en: At the front of the hip of the hanging leg, sometimes into the upper thigh.
feel.zh: 垂低嗰隻腳嘅髖部前面，有時大腿上段都會有。

mistakes.en: Letting the lower back arch off the bed.
Letting go of the held knee.

safety.en: Make sure the bed is stable and you are not too close to falling off.
safety.zh: 確保張床穩陣，唔好瞓到會跌落地。

safety.en: Come out slowly by hugging the knee back in.
safety.zh: 起身要慢，先抱返膝頭。

easier.en: Hold the knee less tightly so the back stays comfortable.
easier.zh: 膝頭抱鬆啲，腰舒服為主。

harder.en: Bend the knee of the hanging leg to bring in the front of the thigh.
harder.zh: 垂低嗰隻腳屈膝，拉埋大腿前面。

summary.en: Sit back on your heels with the tops of the feet flat, then lift the knees slightly.
summary.zh: 腳背貼地坐返落腳跟，再將膝頭微微提起。

steps.en: Kneel with the tops of your feet flat on the floor and toes pointing straight back.
steps.zh: 跪低，腳背貼地，腳趾指向正後方。

steps.en: Sit your hips back onto your heels.
steps.zh: 臀部坐返落腳跟。

steps.en: Place your hands on the floor beside you and lean back a little.
steps.zh: 雙手放喺身旁地上，微微向後挨。

steps.en: Lift the knees a few centimetres off the floor. Hold, then lower.
steps.zh: 膝頭提離地面幾厘米。保持，然後放低。

feel.en: Along the front of the shins and across the front of the ankles.
feel.zh: 小腿前面同腳踝前面。

mistakes.en: Letting the heels splay out to the sides.
Lifting the knees high and quickly.

safety.en: Skip it if kneeling hurts your knees or ankles.
safety.zh: 跪低會令膝頭或者腳踝痛就唔好做。

safety.en: Use a mat or folded towel under the feet.
safety.zh: 腳下面墊瑜伽墊或者摺好嘅毛巾。

easier.en: Sit on the heels without lifting the knees.
easier.zh: 坐喺腳跟上就夠，唔使提膝頭。

harder.en: Stretch one leg at a time with more weight on that side.
harder.zh: 一次拉一隻腳，重心放多啲喺嗰邊。

summary.en: Cross one ankle over the other knee and turn the sole of the foot upward.
summary.zh: 一隻腳眼擱喺另一邊膝頭，將腳掌底轉向上。

steps.en: Sit on a chair and rest your right ankle on your left knee.
steps.zh: 坐喺櫈上，右腳眼擱喺左膝上面。

steps.en: Hold the right foot with your left hand around the outer edge.
steps.zh: 用左手揸住右腳掌外緣。

steps.en: Point the foot slightly, then turn the sole upward toward the ceiling.
steps.zh: 腳尖微微向下指，然後將腳掌底轉向天花板。

steps.en: Hold where the outside of the lower leg and ankle feels stretched, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 小腿外側同腳踝外側有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

feel.en: Along the outside of the lower leg and behind the outer ankle bone.
feel.zh: 小腿外側，同外腳眼後面。

mistakes.en: Twisting the knee instead of the ankle.
Pulling on the toes only.

safety.en: Go gently if you have sprained this ankle before.
safety.zh: 呢隻腳踝以前拗傷過就要輕啲。

safety.en: Stop at any sharp pain.
safety.zh: 有刺痛就停。

easier.en: Turn the sole only part of the way.
easier.zh: 腳掌底轉一半就夠。

harder.en: Hold the shin still with the other hand while turning the foot.
harder.zh: 另一隻手穩住小腿，再轉隻腳。

summary.en: Cross one foot over the knee and pull the toes back toward the shin.
summary.zh: 一隻腳擱喺膝頭上，將腳趾拉向小腿。

steps.en: Sit on a chair and rest your right ankle on your left knee.
steps.zh: 坐喺櫈上，右腳眼擱喺左膝上面。

steps.en: Hold the base of the toes with your right hand.
steps.zh: 用右手揸住腳趾根部。

steps.en: Pull the toes, especially the big toe, back toward the shin until the arch feels taut.
steps.zh: 將腳趾（特別係大腳趾）拉向小腿，直到足弓繃緊。

steps.en: With the other thumb, feel the tight band along the sole. Hold, then switch feet.
steps.zh: 用另一隻拇指摸吓腳底嗰條繃緊嘅筋。保持，然後換腳。

feel.en: Along the arch of the foot, from the heel to the ball.
feel.zh: 足弓，由腳跟去到前腳掌。

mistakes.en: Bending only the tips of the toes.
Letting the ankle point downward.

safety.en: Pull steadily; do not bounce.
safety.zh: 穩定咁拉，唔好彈。

safety.en: Stop at sharp heel pain.
safety.zh: 腳跟有刺痛就停。

easier.en: Pull back only the big toe.
easier.zh: 淨係拉大腳趾。

harder.en: Kneel with the toes tucked under and sit back onto the heels.
harder.zh: 改為跪低，腳趾屈起撐地，再坐返落腳跟。

name.zh: 伸展帶小腿收縮放鬆伸展（PNF）

summary.en: Press the foot into a strap for a few seconds, relax, then pull the toes a little closer.
summary.zh: 腳掌頂住伸展帶幾秒，放鬆，再將腳趾拉近少少。

steps.en: Sit with your right leg straight and a strap around the ball of the foot.
steps.zh: 坐低，右腳伸直，伸展帶套住前腳掌。

steps.en: Pull the strap until the calf feels a first stretch.
steps.zh: 拉條帶，直到小腿啱啱有拉緊感。

steps.en: Press the ball of the foot into the strap at about half strength for 6 seconds without letting the foot move.
steps.zh: 前腳掌用大約一半力頂住條帶 6 秒，隻腳唔好郁。

steps.en: Relax, breathe out, and pull the toes a little closer for about 20 seconds. Repeat, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 放鬆、呼氣，將腳趾再拉近少少，保持大約 20 秒。重複，然後換腳。

feel.en: In the upper calf, behind the knee down to the middle of the lower leg.
feel.zh: 小腿上半部，由膝頭後面去到小腿中間。

mistakes.en: Bending the knee.
Pushing at full strength.

safety.en: Stop if the calf cramps.
safety.zh: 小腿抽筋就停止。

safety.en: Keep the back supported against a wall if needed.
safety.zh: 有需要就背脊挨住牆。

easier.en: Skip the pressing and just hold the stretch.
easier.zh: 唔使頂，淨係保持伸展。

harder.en: Hinge forward slightly from the hips during the relax phase.
harder.zh: 放鬆嗰陣由髖部微微向前傾。

summary.en: Arm straight, palm down, and gently bend the wrist so the fingers point to the floor.
summary.zh: 手伸直、掌心向下，輕輕屈手腕令手指指向地面。

steps.en: Hold your right arm straight out in front, palm facing down.
steps.zh: 右手向前伸直，掌心向下。

steps.en: Let the wrist bend so the fingers point toward the floor.
steps.zh: 手腕向下屈，手指指向地面。

steps.en: With your left hand on the back of the right hand, draw it gently toward you.
steps.zh: 左手放喺右手手背，輕輕拉向自己。

steps.en: Hold, then switch hands.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換手。

feel.en: Along the top of the forearm, up to the outer elbow.
feel.zh: 前臂上面（手背嗰面），一直去到手踭外側。

mistakes.en: Bending the elbow.
Curling the fingers into a tight fist.

safety.en: Pull gently; the wrist should not hurt.
safety.zh: 輕輕拉，手腕唔應該痛。

safety.en: Ease off if the outer elbow is sore.
safety.zh: 手踭外側痛就放鬆啲。

easier.en: Keep a slight bend in the elbow.
easier.zh: 手踭保持微屈。

harder.en: Make a loose fist and turn it slightly outward as you pull.
harder.zh: 握個鬆拳，拉嗰陣微微向外轉。
